subject: Qualification recap — compliance & pen test next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tim McBride <tim.mcbride@healco.com>, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@healco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Qualification recap — compliance & pen test next steps

Hi Tim / Anna — thanks again for the demo and the deep dive today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the security side:  

Key notes from call:
- HealCo requires HIPAA / GDPR controls for patient data flows; SOC 2 Type II in progress (expected audit window: Q4 2026).
- Primary technical ask: recent pen test report and the vulnerability management SLAs (how we handle critical/high/medium findings).
- Procurement wants a vendor security questionnaire (we can start with your standard VSQ).

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
1) HealCo to share most recent pen test summary (redacted ok) and their VSQ contact — target: 3 business days.
2) Redwood to share pen test scope we typically use for cloud-hosted inference: external blackbox + quarterly authenticated scans + annual red-team — deliverable: scope doc (by EOD Wed).
3) Agreement on vulnerability disclosure SLA we suggest: critical = 30 days, high = 45 days, medium/low = 90 days; we can adjust by severity and business impact.
4) Start VSQ intake and schedule SOC 2 evidence handover once audit material is available.

Attachments: redwood_nondisclosure.pdf (NDA we can countersign), intake checklist stub.

Can you confirm a) who will own the VSQ at HealCo, and b) whether redacted pen test PDF is shareable? If you prefer, we can open a short-screen call with our security engineer to align scope.

Thanks — I’ll drop the scope doc shortly and loop Marissa for ongoing onboarding.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Tim McBride <tim.mcbride@healco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@healco.com>, procurement@healco.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 18:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Qualification recap — compliance & pen test next steps

Karthik — appreciate the summary. Anna and I reviewed and attaching a redacted copy of our last external pen test (healco_pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf). We can share additional evidence under NDA.

Couple of clarifications from our side:
- Preferred disclosure SLA historically has been 45 days for critical findings (we have third-party remediation windows to coordinate). Would Redwood be able to accept 45d for critical and 60d for high?
- We need to confirm whether Redwood's scanning cadence supports authenticated scans against our internal staging environment (we prefer scans to occur during an agreed maintenance window).
- SOC 2 evidence point-of-contact will be Anna (anna.lopez@healco.com) — audit expected Oct 2026 but interim evidence may be shared earlier.

I’ve cc’d procurement for contract heads-up. We’ll review the NDA and let you know if we need edits.

—Tim
Director, IT Security, HealCo

Attachments: healco_pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tim McBride <tim.mcbride@healco.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Qualification recap — compliance & pen test next steps

Thanks for the file, Tim — helpful. I’ll own the onboarding & evidence flow from Redwood’s side. A few items I want to put on the table so we’re aligned operationally:  

Suggested scanning & vuln management cadence:
- External unauthenticated scan: weekly (high-level inventory).
- Authenticated full scan: quarterly (staging), with monthly lightweight checks for critical endpoints.
- Annual red-team (opt-in).

Vulnerability disclosure / remediation SLA (Redwood recommendation):
- Critical: remediate or mitigate within 30 days; provide hotfix ETA within 48 hours.
- High: 45 days.
- Medium: 90 days.
- Low: tracked in backlog with quarterly reviews.

If HealCo requires 45 days for critical as Tim suggested, that’s something we can accept for the pilot cohort provided we have two things: 1) agreed scope, and 2) an on-call engineer for urgent triage. Please confirm whether HealCo will accept our proposed triage window for urgent fixes and whether you require a different SLA for P0/P1.

I’ve attached a vuln_sla_template.docx that we typically use as a starting point. Also sharing our VSQ intake form here: https://forms.gle/redwood-vsq-intake (please assign a single owner to complete).

Next steps I’ll take:
- Upload the pen test scope doc to the Drive link in the MAP by EOD today.
- Open the DocuSign for NDA + MSA and loop procurement.

Marissa Cole
Security Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: vuln_sla_template.docx

From: Tim McBride <tim.mcbride@healco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@healco.com>, procurement@healco.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Qualification recap — compliance & pen test next steps

Marissa — that all looks reasonable. A couple quick asks:  
1) Does Redwood support coordinated disclosure exceptions for critical bugs if our internal comms require an embargo for 7–14 days? We have legal constraints sometimes for regulated incidents.
2) For authenticated scans we’ll need a short maintenance window (2 hours) and a staging IP allowlist — can you supply the stub template for required access and credentials?

Anna will be the SOC 2 evidence owner (cc’d). Procurement, please watch for DocuSign.

Tim

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tim McBride <tim.mcbride@healco.com>, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@healco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, procurement@healco.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Qualification recap — compliance & pen test next steps

Thanks all — short summary and committed actions.

Action items (owners / deadlines):
- HealCo: confirm VSQ owner and upload any redacted pen test PDFs to the Drive link (owner: Anna) — due Thu Jul 22.
- Redwood (Marissa): share detailed pen test scope + access template for authenticated scans; upload vuln_sla_template to HubSpot MAP — due Wed Jul 21 EOD.
- Redwood (Karthik): initiate DocuSign for NDA + MSA and add procurement contact — sent Wed Jul 21.
- Security operations alignment: assign on-call engineer for triage (Marissa to propose engineer; timeline: 48 hours after scope finalization).

Notes on SLAs: Redwood can accept a 45-day critical window for the pilot if HealCo confirms an on-call triage path and a mutually agreed maintenance window for authenticated scans. We will document the exception in the MAP so procurement can reference it.

Links / attachments: HubSpot MAP: https://hubspot.company/records/HP-48291 | Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-pen-test-scope | NDA: redwood_nondisclosure.pdf

If everyone agrees, I’ll mark the MAP status to "In progress" and schedule a 30-minute technical touchpoint next week to finalize scope.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
